Question 14

Let f(x,y,z)=9x+2y−z. Find the linear approximation of f at the point (2,1,1).

a
f(x,y,z)≈6+x+2y−2z
b
f(x,y,z)≈8+x−2y−z
c
f(x,y,z)≈6−x−2y+z
d
f(x,y,z)≈6−x+y−z
e
f(x,y,z)≈8−x+y+z
